target.description: Original Fig.2 hand-trajectory decoding from raw or decomposed neural activity, together with original blocked tensor-entry reconstruction error versus rank/type. Neither endpoint can replace the other in the registered combined task.

dataset.description: Author Figshare record24961917/v1 and named Churchland straight/curved arrays are the route; content/version-to-Fig.2 membership and movement/condition artifact hashes remain unverified.

cohort.description: Fig.2 uses monkey J, one session:182 neurons,511 trials (265 center-out and246 maze reaches),12 matched target positions; no unseen-animal claim.

split.description: Released plot_k_fold specifies five folds,20 trial permutations,seed0 separately by straight/curved condition. Recover exact original permutations and confirm treatment of leftover trials and decomposition exposure; new200-case splits cannot substitute. Recover the original reconstruction masks, block trimming and rank-search realizations independently; decoder folds do not define those masks.

inputs.description: Source decoder receives reconstructed or raw neural trajectories plus true initial hand position; trial neural covariates available to unsupervised reconstruction must be disclosed.

preprocessing.description: The original neural tensor uses10ms bins,20ms Gaussian smoothing,whole-session neuronwise min-max scaling and no time warp, covering -1s to+0.5s relative to movement. Qualify the exact decoding time origin/window: Fig2.py slices neural[55:-15] against movement[65:-5] (10-bin lag), whereas Methods describes a -250ms to450ms decoding period. Source arrays and index provenance must resolve this before equivalence.

metric.description: Trial R2=1-SSE/SST, summing squared error across time and XY and centering true position within trial; velocity decoder cumulatively integrates predicted increments from true start. Reconstruction uses the source masked MSE/root-error convention, which must be reconciled for each original panel before comparison.

aggregation.description: Keep separate straight/curved means over trials/folds/permutations and all declared reconstruction comparators. Source figure defines this route, but exact original numerical vectors and OLS-versus-default-ridge parity remain unresolved.

comparison.primary_metric: Fig.2 trial-wise trajectory R2 for straight and curved reaches, reported separately

published_baseline.description: No exact source figure score imported. decoding_r2.npy is named in author figure code; notebook training-loss prints are not published test performance.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No author rerun performed. Recover original figure data and reconcile decoding regularization before qualifying the pinned author route.

minimum_effect.rationale: A useful R2 gain must be justified relative to original trial variability and trajectory scale after authentic source calibration; none is imposed here.

uncertainty.method: A paired trial-level uncertainty procedure preserving repeated-fold dependence must be specified; population generalization beyond this session requires a separately labelled extension.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Reaching trials within one session; neither random permutation nor neuron is an independent animal.
uncertainty.rationale: No confirmatory rule has been admitted. Repeated calculations on the same biological observations do not create independent samples.

paper_win_requires: Recover authentic Fig.2 scores and exact source trial/fold identities, and qualify the original author pipeline before any candidate claim.
Keep original neural/hand inputs, time windows, starting-position access, preprocessing and both reach conditions; no200-case conditional-position substitute.
Resolve OLS stated in paper versus regularization=1 default in released velocity decoding; freeze a source-supported recipe and report any discrepancy.

Recover and retain the original blocked-reconstruction error-versus-rank/type panel, masks, edge trimming and full source comparator set as required companion endpoints. Predeclare a joint decision with decoding; a decoding-only result cannot satisfy the combined registration.

Require a meaningful predeclared improvement against the original source performance with valid uncertainty; reconstruction accuracy, a stronger Wilcoxon p-value or more optimizer restarts alone is insufficient.
A changed split, training-only rescaling or different neuron/session subset is an extension, not surpassing the original paper task.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was reviewed or established.

episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate the original full Fig.2 decoding and original blocked-reconstruction/rank panels with source-matched exposure and a predeclared joint decision; report both reach conditions, protect final labels operationally and disclose prior public exposure.
episode.baseline_policy: Published source scores, authentic author reruns and local engineering controls remain separate. Null episode budgets block active admission.
